runs.rejection_summary: Researched three candidates against the static baseline profile. Two accepted: Carter (81) and Sisu (65), both dense and varied with a capable lead. Warrior was rejected at 52 - the martial arts are excellent but arrive in short bursts, and the period presentation plus heavy drama emphasis pull it under the 60 minimum; that is a verdict about this profile, not about the show. No candidate tripped the action_density hard exclusion this run. Personalization is dormant: no personalized-scores.json exists and none was created. Zero duplicates against the identity set.

Researched two candidates against the static baseline profile and accepted both: Fight or Flight (62) and Heads of State (76). Fight or Flight cleared the minimum on recurring close-quarters combat and stunt-heavy action after its setup; Heads of State cleared comfortably on varied action, pursuit structure, spectacle, conspiracy and ensemble charisma. No candidate tripped the action_density hard exclusion or any combination guardrail. Personalization remains dormant because data/personalized-scores.json is absent. Zero duplicates against the public identity set and watched-exclusion set.
